const styles = {
  page: {
    fontFamily: "Inter,Arial,sans-serif",
    color: "#153c43",
    background: "#fff",
    minHeight: "100vh",
  },
  hero: {
    minHeight: 430,
    padding: "70px 6%",
    display: "flex",
    alignItems: "center",
    background:
      "linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(1,58,59,.96),rgba(1,58,59,.82),rgba(1,58,59,.25)),url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1497366754035-f200968a6e72?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1800&q=90') center/cover",
  },
  heroTitle: {
    fontFamily: "Georgia,serif",
    fontSize: "clamp(40px,5vw,62px)",
    lineHeight: 1,
    color: "#fff",
    margin: 0,
  },
  gold: { color: "#efbe4b" },
  container: {
    width: "min(1200px,calc(100% - 30px))",
    margin: "auto",
  },
  searchBox: {
    marginTop: -30,
    position: "relative",
    zIndex: 3,
    background: "#fff",
    padding: 18,
    borderRadius: 16,
    boxShadow: "0 12px 35px rgba(0,60,60,.15)",
    display: "flex",
    gap: 10,
    flexWrap: "wrap",
  },
  input: {
    height: 45,
    border: "1px solid #d8e6e4",
    borderRadius: 9,
    padding: "0 14px",
    outline: "none",
    fontSize: 13,
    background: "#fff",
  },
  select: {
    height: 45,
    border: "1px solid #d8e6e4",
    borderRadius: 9,
    padding: "0 12px",
    fontSize: 13,
    background: "#fff",
    color: "#264b50",
  },
  section: { padding: "40px 0" },
  grid: {
    display: "grid",
    gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit,minmax(245px,1fr))",
    gap: 16,
  },
  card: {
    position: "relative",
    background: "linear-gradient(145deg,#f7fcfb,#edf7f5)",
    border: "1px solid #dcebe9",
    borderRadius: 14,
    padding: 16,
    display: "flex",
    flexDirection: "column",
    minHeight: 475,
    boxShadow: "0 5px 15px rgba(0,70,70,.04)",
  },
  image: {
    width: "100%",
    height: 125,
    objectFit: "contain",
    borderRadius: 10,
    background: "#fff",
    padding: 12,
  },
  badge: {
    position: "absolute",
    top: 12,
    right: 12,
    background: "#08706d",
    color: "#fff",
    borderRadius: 15,
    padding: "5px 10px",
    fontSize: 10,
    fontWeight: 800,
  },
  title: {
    fontFamily: "Georgia,serif",
    color: "#113c43",
    fontSize: 20,
    lineHeight: 1.15,
    margin: "14px 0 7px",
  },
  description: {
    color: "#596b70",
    fontSize: 12.5,
    lineHeight: 1.45,
    minHeight: 54,
  },
  topics: {
    display: "flex",
    flexWrap: "wrap",
    gap: 6,
    margin: "5px 0 12px",
  },
  topic: {
    background: "#fff",
    border: "1px solid #d7e7e4",
    borderRadius: 20,
    padding: "5px 9px",
    color: "#456267",
    fontSize: 10.5,
    whiteSpace: "nowrap",
  },
  button: {
    border: 0,
    borderRadius: 23,
    background: "#075d5d",
    color: "#fff",
    height: 40,
    fontSize: 12,
    fontWeight: 800,
    cursor: "pointer",
    width: "100%",
  },
  filterBox: {
    margin: "25px 0",
    padding: 16,
    border: "1px solid #dce9e7",
    borderRadius: 12,
    background: "#f7fbfa",
    display: "flex",
    gap: 20,
    flexWrap: "wrap",
    alignItems: "center",
  },
  check: {
    display: "flex",
    gap: 6,
    alignItems: "center",
    fontSize: 12,
    color: "#38585d",
  },
  modalBack: {
    position: "fixed",
    inset: 0,
    zIndex: 9999,
    background: "rgba(4,31,34,.75)",
    display: "flex",
    justifyContent: "center",
    alignItems: "center",
    padding: 15,
  },
  modal: {
    width: "min(850px,100%)",
    maxHeight: "90vh",
    overflowY: "auto",
    background: "#fff",
    borderRadius: 18,
    boxShadow: "0 25px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.3)",
  },
  modalHead: {
    padding: 22,
    background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#075d5d,#0b7370)",
    color: "#fff",
    display: "flex",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
    gap: 15,
  },
  close: {
    border: 0,
    background: "rgba(255,255,255,.15)",
    color: "#fff",
    borderRadius: "50%",
    width: 35,
    height: 35,
    fontSize: 22,
    cursor: "pointer",
  },
  moduleGrid: {
    display: "grid",
    gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))",
    gap: 10,
    padding: 22,
  },
  module: {
    border: "1px solid #dce9e7",
    background: "#f1f8f6",
    borderRadius: 10,
    padding: 15,
    color: "#075d5d",
    fontWeight: 800,
    cursor: "pointer",
    textAlign: "left",
  },
  topicPanel: {
    padding: 22,
  },
  topicGrid: {
    display: "flex",
    flexWrap: "wrap",
    gap: 9,
  },
  topicLarge: {
    padding: "9px 13px",
    background: "#f0f8f6",
    borderRadius: 20,
    color: "#36595e",
    fontSize: 12,
    border: "1px solid #d9e8e5",
  },
};

function CourseCard({ course, onClick, onEnquire }) {
  return (
    <article style={styles.card}>
      {course.badge && <span style={styles.badge}>{course.badge}</span>}

      <img src={course.image} alt={course.title} style={styles.image} />

      <h3 style={styles.title}>{course.title}</h3>

      <p style={styles.description}>{course.description}</p>

      <div style={styles.topics}>
        {course.topics.slice(0, 8).map((item, i) => (
          <span style={styles.topic} key={i}>
            {item}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          display: "flex",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          margin: "auto 0 12px",
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: 800,
          color: "#31565b",
        }}
      >
        <span>◷ {course.duration}</span>
        <span>{course.level}</span>
      </div>

      <button style={styles.button} onClick={() => onClick(course)}>
        View Modules →
      </button>

      <button
        style={{
          ...styles.button,
          marginTop: 8,
          background: "#efbe4b",
          color: "#173d42",
        }}
        onClick={() => onEnquire()}
      >
        Enquire Now →
      </button>
    </article>
  );
}

function CourseModal({ course, onClose, navigate }) {
  const [selectedModule, setSelectedModule] = useState(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const key = (e) => e.key === "Escape" && onClose();
    document.addEventListener("keydown", key);
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", key);
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    };
  }, [onClose]);

  return (
    <div
      style={styles.modalBack}
      onMouseDown={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div style={styles.modal}>
        <div style={styles.modalHead}>
          <div>
            <h2
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Georgia,serif",
                fontSize: 28,
                margin: "0 0 7px",
              }}
            >
              {course.title}
            </h2>

            <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
              {selectedModule
                ? `Topics covered in ${selectedModule.name}`
                : "Select a module below to view its complete topics."}
            </p>
          </div>

          <button style={styles.close} onClick={onClose}>
            ×
          </button>
        </div>

        {!selectedModule ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ padding: "20px 22px 0" }}>
              <h3 style={{ color: "#075d5d", margin: 0 }}>
                Course Modules
              </h3>
              <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#718084" }}>
                Click any module to display only the topics covered in that
                module.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div style={styles.moduleGrid}>
              {course.modules.map((module, i) => (
                <button
                  key={i}
                  style={styles.module}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedModule(module)}
                >
                  <span style={{ marginRight: 8 }}>✓</span>
                  {module.name}
                  <span style={{ float: "right" }}>→</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div style={styles.topicPanel}>
            <button
              onClick={() => setSelectedModule(null)}
              style={{
                border: 0,
                background: "#075d5d",
                color: "#fff",
                borderRadius: 20,
                padding: "9px 16px",
                cursor: "pointer",
                fontWeight: 800,
                fontSize: 12,
                marginBottom: 20,
              }}
            >
              ← Back to Modules
            </button>

            <h2
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Georgia,serif",
                color: "#113c43",
                margin: "0 0 8px",
              }}
            >
              {selectedModule.name}
            </h2>

            <p style={{ color: "#687b7f", fontSize: 12 }}>
              Complete topics covered in this module:
            </p>

            <div style={styles.topicGrid}>
              {selectedModule.topics.map((topic, i) => (
                <span style={styles.topicLarge} key={i}>
                  ✓ {topic}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>

            <button
              style={{ ...styles.button, marginTop: 25 }}
              onClick={() => navigate("/contact")}
            >
              Enquire Now →
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {!selectedModule && (
          <div
            style={{
              padding: "5px 22px 22px",
              display: "flex",
              gap: 10,
              flexWrap: "wrap",
            }}
          >
            <button
              style={{ ...styles.button, flex: 1 }}
              onClick={() => navigate("/contact")}
            >
              Enquire Now →
            </button>

            <button
              style={{
                ...styles.button,
                flex: 1,
                background: "#fff",
                color: "#075d5d",
                border: "1px solid #075d5d",
              }}
              onClick={onClose}
            >
              Close
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Courses() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("All");
  const [level, setLevel] = useState("All");
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState("All");
  const [onlineOnly, setOnlineOnly] = useState(false);
  const [popularOnly, setPopularOnly] = useState(false);
  const [careerOnly, setCareerOnly] = useState(false);
  const [newOnly, setNewOnly] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCourse, setSelectedCourse] = useState(null);

  const filteredCourses = useMemo(() => {
    const text = search.toLowerCase().trim();

    return courses.filter((course) => {
      const searchable =
        `${course.title} ${course.description} ${course.category} ${course.topics.join(
          " "
        )}`.toLowerCase();

      const matchSearch = !text || searchable.includes(text);
      const matchCategory =
        category === "All" || course.category === category;
      const matchLevel = level === "All" || course.level === level;
      const matchDuration =
        duration === "All" || course.duration === duration;
      const matchOnline = !onlineOnly || course.mode === "Online Live";
      const matchPopular = !popularOnly || course.badge === "Popular";
      const matchCareer = !careerOnly || course.badge === "Career";
      const matchNew = !newOnly || course.badge === "New";

      return (
        matchSearch &&
        matchCategory &&
        matchLevel &&
        matchDuration &&
        matchOnline &&
        matchPopular &&
        matchCareer &&
        matchNew
      );
    });
  }, [
    search,
    category,
    level,
    duration,
    onlineOnly,
    popularOnly,
    careerOnly,
    newOnly,
  ]);

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearch("");
    setCategory("All");
    setLevel("All");
    setDuration("All");
    setOnlineOnly(false);
    setPopularOnly(false);
    setCareerOnly(false);
    setNewOnly(false);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Header />

      <main style={styles.page}>
        <section style={styles.hero}>
          <div style={styles.container}>
            <div
              style={{
                color: "#fff",
                fontSize: 12,
                letterSpacing: 3,
                fontWeight: 800,
                marginBottom: 12,
              }}
            >
              OUR COURSES
            </div>

            <h1 style={styles.heroTitle}>
              Future-Ready
              <br />
              Skills for a
              <br />
              <span style={styles.gold}>Better Tomorrow</span>
            </h1>

            <p
              style={{
                color: "#fff",
                maxWidth: 580,
                lineHeight: 1.6,
                fontSize: 14,
              }}
            >
              Industry-focused online courses designed to help you learn,
              build and grow from anywhere in the world.
            </p>
          </div>
        </section>

        <div style={styles.container}>
          <div style={styles.searchBox}>
            <input
              style={{ ...styles.input, flex: "2 1 280px" }}
              placeholder="🔎 Search courses, skills, topics..."
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            />

            <select
              style={{ ...styles.select, flex: "1 1 160px" }}
              value={category}
              onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="All">All Categories</option>
              <option value="Programming">Programming</option>
              <option value="Full Stack">Full Stack</option>
              <option value="Data & Analytics">Data & Analytics</option>
              <option value="AI & Emerging Tech">AI & Emerging Tech</option>
              <option value="Cloud & DevOps">Cloud & DevOps</option>
              <option value="Career Preparation">
                Career Preparation
              </option>
            </select>

            <select
              style={{ ...styles.select, flex: "1 1 150px" }}
              value={level}
              onChange={(e) => setLevel(e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="All">All Levels</option>
              <option value="Beginner">Beginner</option>
              <option value="Advanced">Advanced</option>
            </select>

            <select
              style={{ ...styles.select, flex: "1 1 150px" }}
              value={duration}
              onChange={(e) => setDuration(e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="All">Any Duration</option>
              <option value="3 - 4 Months">3 - 4 Months</option>
              <option value="3 - 5 Months">3 - 5 Months</option>
              <option value="4 - 6 Months">4 - 6 Months</option>
              <option value="4 - 5 Months">4 - 5 Months</option>
              <option value="6 - 8 Months">6 - 8 Months</option>
            </select>

            <button
              style={{
                ...styles.button,
                width: "auto",
                padding: "0 20px",
                background: "#efbe4b",
                color: "#173d42",
              }}
              onClick={clearFilters}
            >
              Clear
            </button>
          </div>

          <div style={styles.filterBox}>
            <strong style={{ color: "#075d5d", fontSize: 13 }}>
              Advanced Filters:
            </strong>

            <label style={styles.check}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={onlineOnly}
                onChange={(e) => setOnlineOnly(e.target.checked)}
              />
              Online Live
            </label>

            <label style={styles.check}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={popularOnly}
                onChange={(e) => setPopularOnly(e.target.checked)}
              />
              Popular Courses
            </label>

            <label style={styles.check}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={careerOnly}
                onChange={(e) => setCareerOnly(e.target.checked)}
              />
              Career Preparation
            </label>

            <label style={styles.check}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={newOnly}
                onChange={(e) => setNewOnly(e.target.checked)}
              />
              New Courses
            </label>
          </div>

          <section style={styles.section}>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 25 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  color: "#075d60",
                  fontSize: 11,
                  letterSpacing: 3,
                  fontWeight: 800,
                }}
              >
                EXPLORE OUR COURSES
              </div>

              <h2
                style={{
                  fontFamily: "Georgia,serif",
                  color: "#103c43",
                  fontSize: "clamp(30px,4vw,43px)",
                  margin: "6px 0",
                }}
              >
                Choose Your{" "}
                <span style={{ color: "#bd8b25" }}>Learning Path</span>
              </h2>

              <p style={{ color: "#687b7f", fontSize: 13 }}>
                Showing {filteredCourses.length} of {courses.length} courses
              </p>
            </div>

            {filteredCourses.length > 0 ? (
              <div style={styles.grid}>
                {filteredCourses.map((course, i) => (
                  <CourseCard
                    key={i}
                    course={course}
                    onClick={setSelectedCourse}
                    onEnquire={() => navigate("/contact")}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div
                style={{
                  textAlign: "center",
                  padding: "60px 20px",
                  border: "1px solid #dce9e7",
                  borderRadius: 15,
                  background: "#f7fbfa",
                }}
              >
                <h3 style={{ color: "#075d5d" }}>No Courses Found</h3>
                <p style={{ color: "#718084", fontSize: 13 }}>
                  Try changing your search or filters.
                </p>
                <button
                  style={{ ...styles.button, width: 150 }}
                  onClick={clearFilters}
                >
                  Clear Filters
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>
      </main>

      <Footer />

      {selectedCourse && (
        <CourseModal
          course={selectedCourse}
          navigate={navigate}
          onClose={() => setSelectedCourse(null)}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
